title: Relation Inference
description: The derived finding that a candidate observer is, or is not, independent of a subject. Independence is inferred from the record and is never declared by the observer: a declared relation would be the observer vouching for itself, which is the same substitution as an executor's report standing in for an observation. Two axes are walked, and neither substitutes for the other (decisions/0104). Context is what the observer was given: removable at launch. Perspective is what the observer is: removable only by being a different actor, because a later session of one actor is a version of it and reads the artifact the way the first one did. The walk is scoped to the subject's standing lifecycle rather than to one run, so an actor at an earlier arrow cannot be admitted as its own witness at a later one. The edge set is closed. One edge found is DIRECT. None found, over a complete record, is INDEPENDENT. A record too thin to answer is UNDETERMINED and refuses, because absence of a recorded edge is not absence of a relation.

candidate_observer_id.description: The actor proposed as observer. Proposing is not declaring independence.

executor_id.description: The actor the run's record attributes the execution to, read from that record rather than supplied by the candidate.

subject_id.description: The standing subject the run belongs to, read from the run's own ATTEMPTED entry. Absent means the lifecycle edge cannot be answered, which is UNDETERMINED and never independence.

edges_examined.description: Every direct edge this inference looked for. The set is closed: an edge outside it cannot be examined, and a candidate connected by an unlisted route reads as independent. That is the enforcement surface of the whole service.

edges_found.description: The examined edges that held. Non-empty means DIRECT.

record_completeness.description: Whether the run's record carried enough to answer every examined edge. INCOMPLETE forces UNDETERMINED; it never reads as independence.

unanswerable_edges.description: Edges the record could not answer. Required to be non-empty when record_completeness is INCOMPLETE, so an incomplete verdict names what it could not see.

evidence_addresses.description: What the inference read to reach its finding. An inference that read nothing has not inferred.

edge.description: A direct relation between a candidate observer and a subject, on one of the two axes. Perspective: SAME_ACTOR_VERSION, PRIOR_STANDING_ACTOR. Context: the rest. GRANT_DESCENDS_FROM_RUN was retired by decisions/0104 - authority descent is an authority fact, and the hazard it stood for (a builder that can bury a finding it dislikes) is ONLY_EXECUTOR_REPORT.

evidence_address.description: Where in the run's record this edge was seen. A found edge with no address is an assertion, not a finding.

oneOf.description: DIRECT: at least one edge held. The candidate may not observe this run.

INDEPENDENT: no edge held and the record answered every one of them. unanswerable_edges must be absent or empty here, and only here: a DIRECT verdict may name an edge it could not answer, because a found edge already answers the question the inference asks, but independence claimed over an edge nobody could read is the silence-as-pass this contract refuses.
UNDETERMINED: the record could not answer. Refuses; never reads as independence.
